name: 24-Hour Room Service Penne Bolognaise with Parmigiano-Reggiano
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · 24-Hour Stateroom Dining
whyItWorks: Soft white penne pasta with finely ground beef Bolognese and lactose-free aged Parmigiano-Reggiano.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip the garlic-rubbed crostini if sensitive to garlic fructans; during an active flare, ask if the kitchen can send plain buttered penne pasta.
watchOuts: Onion/garlic soffritto and tomato acidity in Bolognese sauce
